objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the P&R system subject to creation, editing, release, and archiving

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Category of document such as Policy, Guideline, ProcedureInstruction, or WorkInstruction

attributes.name: documentlevel
attributes.description: Hierarchical level from 1 to 4 indicating strategic importance and scope

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: System-generated code prefix for document identification

attributes.name: sequentialnumber
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive number assigned per document type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or description of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Editing, InReview, Released, or OutOfForce

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number assigned to released document

attributes.name: validfrom
attributes.description: Date when document becomes effective

attributes.name: validuntil
attributes.description: Expiration date of document validity

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Area or application domain of the document

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person who interacts with documents in various roles

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Function such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: Collection of users with shared permissions or responsibilities

attributes.name: grouptype
attributes.description: Category such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, or BusinessAdmin

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document component that is released with the main document and has its own versioning

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of attachment such as Editing, Released, or Archived

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: Uncontrolled document component not subject to release cycle or versioning

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Type or content summary of additional information

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: Formal suggestion for document modification without affecting version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending, Scheduled, or Completed

objs.name: validityrequest
objs.description: Workflow request to confirm or extend document validity

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Extension or Override

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: Request to restore an archived document to active status

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Pending or Confirmed

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: Record of users and groups assigned for document notification

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Email or Acknowledgement

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of document receipt and understanding by a user

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Pending or Confirmed

objs.name: languageversion
objs.description: Translated version of a released document in a specific language

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language code or name of the translation

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied during workflow approval

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of signature application

objs.name: template
objs.description: Standard format or structure used to create new documents

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Type of document this template applies to

objs.name: client
objs.description: Organizational entity or instance in a multi-client system

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document object in the system with selected document type and optional template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document content, metadata, or properties during editing status

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Add or update standardized and custom metadata attributes of a document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant specific permissions to users or user groups for document access and modification

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Designate a user as the primary author responsible for document content

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate a user to perform technical and formal content validation

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate a user authorized to approve and publish a document

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Grant viewing permissions to a user or user group

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attach a controlled document component to a main document

evts.name: add_additionalinfo
evts.description: Append uncontrolled supplementary content to a document

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate workflow to request reviewer assessment of document content

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Perform technical and formal validation of document during review workflow step

evts.name: request_release
evts.description: Initiate final approval step in document release workflow

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document, making it visible to authorized readers

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply electronic signature during workflow approval step

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw document from active circulation and restrict access

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm ongoing validity of a document for an additional period

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document invalid and remove it from circulation

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an archived document to active status and re-validate it

evts.name: create_changeproposal
evts.description: Submit a formal suggestion for document modification without version change

evts.name: implement_changeproposal
evts.description: Incorporate a change proposal into a new document version

evts.name: maintain_distributionlist
evts.description: Assign users and user groups to receive document notifications

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify distribution list members via email upon document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require distribution list members to actively confirm document receipt

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Approve receipt and understanding of a document by a user

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-specific version of a released document

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Validate translated content during translation approval workflow

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve translated document version for distribution to language-specific readers

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: System automatic conversion of edited document to PDF format

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Present document content to authorized users via web interface

o2o.description: Document references another document as part of its governance or content structure
Document is created from or based on a specific template
Attachment is a controlled component of a Document
AdditionalInfo is uncontrolled supplementary content attached to a Document
ChangeProposal is associated with and proposes modifications to a Document
LanguageVersion is a translated version of a Document
DistributionList specifies users and groups to be notified about Document release
User belongs to a UserGroup with shared permissions
ValidityRequest is created for and applies to a specific Document
ReactivationRequest targets a specific Document for reactivation
Attachment may be archived when replaced by newer version of main Document
Document visibility and applicability is defined per Client in multi-client system

o2e.description: Authorization is assigned for a Document
Reader access is granted for Document
ValidityRequest is processed to extend validity
Document is declared invalid and archived
User incorporates change proposal into new version
New Document version is created from ChangeProposal
User is requested to confirm document receipt
Acknowledgement workflow is initiated for Document
Document is automatically converted to PDF format
User views document via web interface
Document content is displayed to user
